fragments.contract: On the clean 10 VIDEO Trixie base, install native Keystone, Horizon, Glance, Placement, Nova, and Neutron/OVS through BKC SSH scripts and validate Horizon, Keystone token issue, Nova compute, Neutron endpoints, and Neutron agents.
fragments.why_it_matters: The native script path replaced the earlier Kolla rabbit hole for this lab. It is simple, direct, and closer to the normal sysctl/config-file/service model BKC is meant to automate.
fragments.do_not_repeat: Do not reintroduce Kolla, Kubernetes, or a second local OpenStack control plane as the default lab path unless a new pipeline explicitly proves that provider.

fragments.contract: Horizon must be reachable through the lab edge at http://swarm1.lab.auzietek.com:8082/ and may require browser-session validation in addition to curl redirect checks.
fragments.why_it_matters: A curl 302/200 proves service routing, but browser login/session behavior can still differ because Horizon/Django depends on host, forwarded host, CSRF, and cookie behavior.
fragments.do_not_repeat: Do not treat a browser double-login symptom as proof that Keystone/Nova/Neutron are broken. First isolate edge headers and Horizon cookie behavior.
